_doc: Maps provider service names (as they appear in billing / OpenCost cloudCost 'service') and Kubernetes asset types into our cost categories. Matching is case-insensitive regex, first match wins.

services.match: ^(AmazonEC2|Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud.*|Compute Engine|Microsoft.Compute|Virtual Machines|EC2 - Other)$

^(AmazonRDS|Amazon Relational Database Service|AmazonDynamoDB|AmazonElastiCache|AmazonDocDB|AmazonNeptune|AmazonRedshift|Cloud SQL|Cloud Spanner|Firestore|Bigtable|Memorystore|Microsoft.Sql|Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL|Microsoft.DBforMySQL|Microsoft.DocumentDB|Azure Database.*|Cosmos DB|Redis Cache)$
^(AWSLambda|AWS Lambda|AmazonAPIGateway|AWS Step Functions|AWSAppSync|Cloud Functions|Cloud Run|Microsoft.Web|Azure Functions|App Service)$

^(AmazonVPC|Amazon Virtual Private Cloud|AmazonCloudFront|AmazonRoute53|AWSELB|Elastic Load Balancing|AWS Direct Connect|AWSGlobalAccelerator|Cloud Load Balancing|Cloud CDN|Cloud DNS|Networking|Microsoft.Network|Virtual Network|Load Balancer|Content Delivery Network)$

^(AWSIdentityAndAccessManagement|AmazonCognito|AWS Directory Service|AWSSecretsManager|AWS Key Management Service|awskms|Cloud IAM|Identity Platform|Secret Manager|Cloud KMS|Microsoft.AAD|Azure Active Directory|Microsoft.KeyVault|Key Vault)$

^(AmazonEKS|Amazon Elastic Container Service for Kubernetes|AmazonECS|AmazonECR|AWSFargate|Kubernetes Engine|Google Kubernetes Engine|Artifact Registry|Microsoft.ContainerService|Azure Kubernetes Service|Container Registry|Kubernetes)$
